texts.preamble: Saijo Joseph vs The State Of Kerala on 25 July, 2012 Author: A.M.Shaffique Bench: A.M.Shaffique In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present: The Hon'Ble The Chief Justice Dr. Manjula Chellur & The Honourable Mr.Justice A.M.Shaffique Thursday, The 5Th Day Of December 2013/14Th Agrahayana, 1935 WP(C).No. 28034 of 2013 (S) ---------------------------- Petitioner : ---------- Saijo Joseph, Aged 29 Years S/O.Joseph, Kollarakkal House, Parappuram P.O.,Kalady, Kanjoor - 683 593. By Adv. Sri.Biju Abraham Respondents : ----------- 1. The State Of Kerala, Represented By Its Secretary To Health And Family Welfare Department Secretariat, Thiruvananthapuram - 695 001. 2. The Commissioner Of Food Safety (Kerala), Thaikadu P.O., Thiruvananthapuram - 695 014. 3. The Director Of Health Services, Department Of Health And Family Welfare Thiruvananthapuram - 695 001. By Senior Government Pleader Sri. P.I. Davis Saijo Joseph vs The State Of Kerala on 25 July, 2012 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151268998/ 1 This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Come Up For Admission On 05-12-2013, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following: Bp WP(C).No. 28034 of 2013 (S) ---------------------------- Appendix Petitioner(S)' Exhibits ------------------------ Exhibit P1 : A True Copy Of The Circular Dated 25-07-2012 Issued By The 2Nd Respondent Respondent(S)' Exhibits : Nil. ----------------------- //True Copy// P.A. To Judge Bp Manjula Chellur, C.J & A.M.Shaffique, J. ---------------------------------------------- W.P(C).No. 28034 of 2013 ---------------------------------------------- Dated this the 5th December, 2013 Judgment
texts.facts: The main complaint of the petitioner is that though caterers also come within the ambit of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the respondent authorities having issued Exhibit P1 circular indicating the necessity for taking of precautionary measures in terms of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, which is applicable only to hotels and restaurants, no such steps have been initiated by the Government as far as the caterers are concerned.
texts.arguments: According to the petitioner, there are large number of catering organisations within the State and unless such safety measures are being implemented, there will be no control in respect of the food supplied by such organisations. 3. The learned Government Pleader, on instructions, would submit that necessary steps have already been taken by the respondent authorities to insist for compliance of requirement under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Rules framed thereunder.
texts.petitioner_arguments: According to the petitioner, there are large number of catering organisations within the State and unless such safety measures are being implemented, there will be no control in respect of the food supplied by such organisations. 3.
